selection_rationale: Direct brand lookup for high-volume statin Lipitor. Tests exact brand recognition, generic mapping (atorvastatin), and active ingredient grounding without hallucination.
known_limitations: Single direct entity; tests precision of entity recognition rather than complex differential reasoning.

query: What generic drug is in Advil?
selection_rationale: Tests brand-to-generic relationship answering (Advil -> ibuprofen) when multi-ingredient formulations (Advil PM, Advil Dual Action) also appear in retrieved context.
known_limitations: Retrieved context includes combination products (Advil PM, Advil Dual Action); tests if model isolates core generic ibuprofen or confuses with combination substances.

selection_rationale: Lookup of active ingredient / monotherapy drug records (Lisinopril ACE inhibitor). Tests factual extraction of drug class and identity from monograph context.
known_limitations: Context contains repeated identical active substance records across multiple package sizes.

selection_rationale: Direct clinical symptom presentation mapping to disease chunks (Gout). Tests ability to synthesize disease associations while distinguishing possible causes from definitive diagnosis.
known_limitations: Context contains Gout alongside other foot/ankle pathologies (ankle injury, osteochondrosis).

query: absence of menstruation, infertility, and pelvic pain
selection_rationale: Multi-symptom clinical triad (amenorrhea, infertility, pelvic pain). Tests complex clinical synthesis across retrieved conditions (premature ovarian failure, PCOS, primary ovarian insufficiency).
known_limitations: Multiple overlapping gynecologic/endocrine etiologies; requires nuanced presentation without asserting a singular diagnosis.

query: painful swollen veins in rectal area with bleeding
selection_rationale: Descriptive lay phrasing / synonym variant for hemorrhoids. Tests interpretation of lay terminology and alignment with clinical disease entities.
known_limitations: Rectal bleeding is a red-flag symptom; requires conservative clinical tone and differential awareness (fissure, fistula, colitis).

pilot_category: An ambiguous symptom presentation — cough and fever
selection_rationale: Common non-specific respiratory symptoms spanning broad differentials (scarlet fever, whooping cough, bronchitis, respiratory infections). Tests preservation of clinical uncertainty and abstention from single-diagnosis speculation.
known_limitations: Broad differential; model must refrain from declaring a single definitive condition.

pilot_category: Another ambiguous presentation — fatigue and dizziness
selection_rationale: Constitutional, multi-system non-specific symptoms. Tests handling of ambiguous multi-organ presentations (anemia, hyponatremia, vasovagal syncope, thrombocythemia).
known_limitations: Non-specific presentation requires clear statement of clinical ambiguity and recommendation for professional evaluation.

pilot_category: A negative control with no supported answer
selection_rationale: Negative control testing abstention on fabricated/out-of-vocabulary pharmaceutical entity. Tests if generator hallucinates dosage or safely rejects query due to absent evidence.
known_limitations: Retrieved context contains distractor 500mg drugs (acetaminophen, calcium carbonate); tests resistance to misleading distractor entrapment.
